title: Defining and Generating Compositional Structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.20922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Compositional structure is pervasive in nature and across scales: atoms combine into molecules, molecules into cells, and cells into organisms, while further compositional hierarchies appear within each level. More broadly, compositionality, the reuse and recombination of parts into novel structures, is a fundamental source of interesting complexity in both natural and artificial systems. Yet despite its importance, and despite our apparent ease in recognizing it, mathematical accounts capturing what we intuitively mean by compositional structure remain limited. Here, we fill this gap by formalizing a simple idea: compositional structure emerges when parts, considered together, reveal shared structure that is not captured when those parts are modeled separately. translated_abstract: 组合结构在自然界中无处不在，并跨越各个尺度：原子组合成分子，分子组合成细胞，细胞组合成生物体，同时在每个层级内部还呈现出进一步的组合层级。更广泛地说，组合性——即部分的复用与重组以构成新结构——是自然与人工系统中有趣复杂性的根本来源。然而，尽管其重要性不言而喻，尽管我们显然能轻松识别它，但能够捕捉我们直觉上所理解的组合结构的数学化论述仍然有限。在此，我们通过将一个简单的想法形式化来填补这一空白：当若干部分被放在一起考虑时，会显现出在单独建模这些部分时无法捕捉到的共享结构，此时便产生了组合结构。我们借助算法信息论——信息与压缩的数学——来表达这一思想，该理论为在任意数据中识别结构提供了一种自然的方式，而无需……
tldr: 该论文利用算法信息论将组合结构形式化定义为“当部分被整体考虑时会显现出单独建模时无法捕捉的共享结构”，从而为在任意数据中识别和生成这种结构提供了数学框架。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes compositional structure using algorithmic information theory—defining it as the phenomenon where parts considered together reveal shared structure not captured when modeled separately—providing a mathematical framework for identifying and generating such structure in arbitrary data.
